**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep the post-merge gate unsatisfied until exact-SHA evidence exists**

For merge commit `d8b15cb`, the archived `ci.yml` run 39051543180 is cancelled; the successful run 39053830242 tested the different commit `d347d42`. Ancestry establishes that the latter contains the packet, but does not make it an exact-SHA gate result. Declaring the gate satisfied here leaves the owner decision as the apparent sole remaining land condition, despite missing required evidence. Keep this condition unmet and describe the descendant run as supplemental evidence until an exact-merge-SHA run succeeds or durable authority explicitly accepts replacement evidence under protocol §10.2.1. Validate that the reported gate SHA matches the merge SHA, while handling an explicitly authorized substitution separately so legitimate exceptions are not lost.
